sources.title: Can Pech
sources.note: Infobox 1441-1540, capital Campeche; Spanish ship 22 March 1517; invasions 1527, 1531, 1540; population 36,000 in 1517; south of Ah Canul and north of Chakan Putum.

notes: NEW STATE. Cliopatria has no row for this province; Later Mayan City-States (1429-1546, 135,136 to 187,745 km2) covers the whole northern lowlands and contains it. The Kuchkabal page says the extent of the provinces 'is still debated' and that scholars disagree 'on whether they were territorial units or jurisdictions'; the shape here is a disc around the capital, soft, and no frontier is claimed. Cliopatria keeps its envelope to 1546 although the Spanish took the provinces one by one from 1527. CAN PECH. The page is long and runs from the Toltecs 'in the early 900s' and 'the League of Mayapan became the main power in the area in 987' to the conquest; the dates 900s/987 were not used (Mayapan page: the 1220s). The Spanish ship docked at Campeche 'on March 22, 1517'. Gazetteer resolves 'Campeche'.
